items.title: The Bull Case For Analog Devices (ADI) Could Change Following Lofty Earnings Projections In Key End Markets
items.summary: In the lead-up to its recent earnings release, Wall Street analysts projected that Analog Devices would report quarterly earnings of US$3.33 per share and revenues of US$3.92 billion, implying very large year-over-year growth in both profit and sales. Analysts also anticipated especially strong revenue contributions from communications and industrial markets, highlighting how demand across these segments could reshape Analog Devices’ mix of business and earnings drivers.
